svg.title: Pemeriksaan pengembalian dana
svg.metadata: {"authoring":"native-vector","brief":"Original editorial doodle for Buatin, a service turning website briefs into planning documents. Controlled hand-drawn rounded ink lines, slight irregularity, simple shapes, generous negative space. Forest green #235C46, ink #202B27, sage #E4EEE7, restrained yellow #F3D37A. Transparent background. No written words, gradients, 3D, heavy shadows, watermarks, stock characters, or certification badges. Match this asset family's geometry. A plain transaction receipt with abstract line marks and one returning curved arrow. Calm composition without currency symbols or approval stamps."}
